description: Calculate the official تعرفهٔ دستمزد کارشناسان رسمی دادگستری as replaced by the 1405 instrument (approved 1405/05/07, promulgated 1405/05/20; supersedes the 1398/12/25 tariff and its 1402 amendment). `valuation` is a marginal ladder on the ارزش موضوع کارشناسی (art. 11) with a hard per-expert cap (1,350,000,000 rial) and explicit percentage add-ons for a few named subject matters (art. 11 notes 3–4, art. 22(2)); `residual` is expert work with no specific tariff in this instrument (art. 9) — a RANGE of 20,000,000–100,000,000 rial set on the expert's proposal with the referring authority's agreement, and the tool returns only the floor and says so; `evidence` is the flat minimum for تأمین دلیل (art. 7, 20,000,000 rial). Dozens of OTHER specialties (arts. 13–55) carry their own separate tariff and are not modelled here. Never guess a court expert's statutory fee.

expert_count.description: Number of same-specialty experts working the SAME subject jointly (valuation only). More than 1 applies a 30% reduction per expert, with the cap checked after the reduction (art. 56). Default 1 (no reduction). Do not use for a multi-specialty panel — price each specialty separately.

kind.description: valuation = art. 11 ladder (needs value_rial); residual = flat minimum, no specific tariff (art. 9); evidence = تأمین دلیل flat minimum (art. 7).

modifiers.description: valuation only; usually at most one: contract_dispute = employer/contractor/consulting-engineer dispute or صورت‌وضعیت review over the whole contract value (+100%, art. 11 note 3); contract_dispute_partial = appraisal of only part of the contract, e.g. finding breach or delay (+50%, note 3); intangible_assets = valuation of intangible assets such as brands (+50%, art. 11 note 4 in the 1405 tariff); underground_mine = underground mineral reserves (+35%, art. 22(2)).

travel_days_other_province.description: Mission days outside the expert's own province (art. 6).

travel_days_same_province.description: Mission days within the expert's own province (art. 6 daily travel allowance) — added to any kind.

value_rial.description: Value of the subject matter under appraisal, in RIAL — valuation only. Never pass Toman.
